senses.example: Sunning himself on the board steps, I saw for the first time Mr. Farquhar Fenelon Cooke.[…]A silver snaffle on a heavy leather watch guard which connected the pockets of his corduroy waistcoat, together with a huge gold stirrup in his Ascot tie, sufficiently proclaimed his tastes.

senses.definition: To make (something) the subject of an official proclamation bringing it within the scope of emergency powers.
senses.example: Were those baronies proclaimed at the time you were in them? –Some of them are; the barony of Duhallow is proclaimed.
